internal_consistency.verdict: Group means are consistent with the overall mean, but the reported group SDs (1.69, 1.62) imply an overall SD of ~1.65 and t = 1.93 (p = 0.056), not the reported SD 1.78 and t = 1.790 (p = 0.0765). The reported t and overall SD are mutually consistent with a pooled SD of ~1.76, so the group SDs printed in Section 4.4 / Figure 4 are probably mis-transcribed. Resolve by recomputing from the raw results file.

notes: The paper's t = 1.790 is Student's pooled-variance t; Welch's t is reported here as requested by R2.5.
The 95% CI for the mean difference includes 0 under both tests, so the result is inconclusive (R3.4).
The CI for Cohen's d spans from a negligible-to-negative effect to a large one; d = 0.52 is not a precise estimate.
Power figures assume the observed d is the true effect; they illustrate why n = 100 (16 vs 84) was underpowered.
